title: Resolve the rail-meter radius gap -- option (a), QSS rule beside DsCookBar
change: Joe ruled option (a) on the one design gap L5-11 logged. Implement exactly that, derive nothing new. (1) In python/synapse/panel/designsystem/qss.py, add a #DsRailMeter rule immediately beside the existing #DsCookBar rule, matching its construction: the same 2px-on-3px radius treatment DsCookBar already establishes as design intent, with idle and busy colours expressed as a dynamic Qt property selector (idle -> SIGNAL_TINT, busy -> WARM) using the tokens already in use at the call sites. (2) In synapse_panel.py, remove the inline stylesheet radius literals at both DsRailMeter sites (_build_rail and _set_busy) and the DESIGN-GAP(L5-11) markers with them; drive the state change by setting the dynamic property and calling designsystem.components.repolish(), following the existing _set_face idiom in the same file. Behaviour must be identical: idle and busy still render as they do now. (3) In docs/PROFILES.md, replace the 'Design gaps for human decision' entry with a short resolved note under the heading 'Derived design decisions' -- one line, in the form 'X derived from Y because Z': the rail meter radius derives from #DsCookBar because the vendored source of truth already establishes 2px-on-3px for the identical widget shape. Keep the paragraph explaining that the conformance test permits waivers only via a registered DESIGN-GAP marker. Add nothing else and change no other copy.

accept.note: seat: rail meter looks unchanged idle and busy
